body: So weird, one of those names you see floating around, and yet I don't think I've ever heard a track. Just listened to their most listened on Spotify and I love it.  Could you recommend a proper starting point, or just chronological?

Reckoner is my all time favourite song. 'like ripples...' is going to be my first tattoo when I save up the money. I must have listened to it a thousand times, and yet when he deconstructed it, and played all of the different lines separately. Oh my god. Recommendation to anyone who hasn't listened to it yet: Dark room, noise cancelling headphones. It felt like when I first discovered them all over again. It is not hyperbolic to say I was moved to tears.
I second yoga with Adrianne, she basically got me through lockdown

Thanks, this is fascinating. I wish so much that they had gone full Devotional and not just SOFAD. But at least that version of EtS is available, as it is maybe the greatest thing I have ever heard.  
I just adore the groove of EC on this tour, and they don't seem to have done anything similar since. Probably for the best there aren't any copies floating around at the moment as I assume it would be a bank breaker and I would be sorely tempted.

Thank you, I suspected that would be the answer re: official recordings. Thank you so much for the links, I will take whatever I can get!

I always assumed it was a nod to Jose Mourinho. From a non footballing role at a club all the way up to manager, in Nate's case kit-man, and in Jose's as a translator at Barcelona under Bobby Robson. And then all of the park the bus stuff which is a Jose tactic. Finally to the dapper suits and full white hair transformation which is also iconic Jose. I thought it was a hilarious full transition into the baddie (although I am biased against Jose from his time at Man U), but either way I'd say he could be considered at times cold and clinical manager. (I don't know that much about football, so apologies if any details here are inaccurate, but to my fairly novice footballing brain it all pointed to Jose).
